title: General Programming
description: Core programming concepts: data structures, algorithms, Python, Git and the web.

questions.text: What does CPU stand for?
questions.explanation: CPU stands for Central Processing Unit, the part of a computer that executes instructions.

questions.text: Which data structure follows the LIFO (last in, first out) principle?
questions.explanation: In a stack the last element pushed is the first one popped.

questions.text: What does HTML stand for?
questions.explanation: HTML is the HyperText Markup Language used to structure web pages.

questions.text: Which symbol starts a single-line comment in Python?
questions.explanation: Python comments start with # and continue to the end of the line.

questions.text: What is the result of 7 // 2 in Python?
questions.explanation: // is floor division, so 7 // 2 equals 3.

questions.text: What is the time complexity of binary search on a sorted array?
questions.explanation: Binary search halves the search range each step, so it takes O(log n) time.

questions.text: What does a compiler do?
choices: Translates source code into machine code before it runs
Runs a program line by line
questions.explanation: A compiler translates the whole source code into machine code before execution.

questions.text: Which keyword defines a function in Python?
questions.explanation: Functions in Python are defined with the def keyword.

questions.text: What does SQL stand for?
questions.explanation: SQL is the Structured Query Language used to work with relational databases.

questions.text: What type does the input() function return in Python?
questions.explanation: input() always returns a string, even if the user types digits.

questions.text: What is recursion?
questions.explanation: Recursion is when a function solves a problem by calling itself on a smaller input.

questions.text: What does OOP stand for?
questions.explanation: OOP is Object-Oriented Programming, built around objects and classes.

questions.text: In object-oriented programming, what is a class?
questions.explanation: A class describes the data and behaviour that its objects will have.

questions.text: Which HTTP status code means 'Not Found'?
questions.explanation: 404 tells the client that the requested resource does not exist.

questions.text: Which Python collection type is immutable?
questions.explanation: A tuple cannot be changed after it is created.

questions.text: What is the index of the first element of a Python list?
questions.explanation: Python lists are zero-indexed, so the first element is at index 0.

questions.text: What does API stand for?
questions.explanation: An API is an Application Programming Interface that lets programs talk to each other.

questions.text: Which sorting algorithm repeatedly swaps adjacent elements that are in the wrong order?
questions.explanation: Bubble sort keeps swapping neighbouring elements until the list is sorted.

questions.text: What is the decimal number 5 in binary?
questions.explanation: 5 = 4 + 1, which is 101 in binary.

questions.text: Which Python keywords are used to handle exceptions?
questions.explanation: Code that may fail goes in a try block and the error is handled in except.
